main_text.p: tingere. Sæpe pro He habet Aleph. Niphal נִקְרָה Obvium exhibuit se, Obvium fieri. Pihel קֵרָה Contignare, Contabulare. Hiphil הִקְרָה Obvenire fecit.
קֹרָה f. Tignum, Trabs: plur. קֹרוֹת.
קְרִי ׳ קֵרָה m. [?] Accidens, Eventus, Casus. קְרָאָה f Occursus. מִקְרֶה m. Contignatio.
קִרְיָה ׳ קִרְיַת f. urbs, Civitas. Chald. idem: קִרְיָתָא in urbe; קִרְיָא מְרְדָא Civitas ista, civitas rebellis est, Esr.4.10.15.
קָרַח Glabrare se, Calvitiū sibi inducere. Niphal נִקְרַח Glabrari, Calvitium induci. Hiphil הִקְרִיחַ Glabrum, Calvum effecit. Hophal Partic. מְקֻרָּח Decalvatum.
קָרֵחַ m. Calvus. קִרְחַת f. Calvitium.
קֶרַח ׳ קְרָח m. Gelu, Glacies, Cryftallum.
קָרַן Radiare, Splendere. Hiphil הִקְרִין Cornua produxit, ex Nomine derivato.
קֶרֶן c. Cornu: metaphoricè Robur, quòd cornua sunt animalium robur: duale קַרְנַיִם, קַרְנַיִם, quia proprie duo cornua animalia gestant. Fœmin. קַרְנוֹת.
קַרְנָא ׳ קַרְנִין Chal. idem: plur. קַרְנַיָּא & קַרְנִין.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points in several entries are faint on the scan; those readings are best effort. The first word of the Hebrew line after "קְרִי" is doubtful, marked [?]. The right-aligned final word is a single Hebrew word, transcribed as printed.
